stageMatrix.title: firmware identity
stageMatrix.basis: Owner read-only physical device build, kernel, bootstate, SELinux identity

stageMatrix.title: source firmware extraction and provenance
stageMatrix.basis: Pinned original extracted boot Image config source and BL inputs; raw kernel-memory equality not proven

stageMatrix.title: stock ABI/source-to-code
stageMatrix.basis: Recovered nm and stock opcode/source crosswalk, selected field matches, no authenticated complete OEM local/structure DWARF

stageMatrix.title: physical kernel load and BL handoff
stageMatrix.basis: BL/boot-v2/DTB evidence; no authenticated physical running Linux load base or runtime DTB selection

stageMatrix.title: runtime address/slide assumptions
stageMatrix.basis: Runtime per-boot KASLR, stack object behavior and relevant physical identity not proven

stageMatrix.title: native target
stageMatrix.basis: Unprivileged identity-only ARM64 diagnostic does not constitute working privilege chain

stageMatrix.title: 4.19 KernelSU
stageMatrix.basis: SIG_FORCE=y, KPROBES=n, RKP/KDP/DEFEX, no trusted-compatible module/hooks/loader demonstrated

stageMatrix.title: app support feed
stageMatrix.basis: No hardware-verified root and 4.19 KernelSU integration; research-only profile

stageMatrix.title: retention and recovery
stageMatrix.basis: Original artifacts preserved, no hardware/root release recovery signoff

caveat: This checkpoints already recorded evidence, not a new handset verification run. Do not promote stages based on static or QEMU evidence alone; user run of y2q_porting_readiness.py remains authoritative. No production target/header/feed change.
